scientific_integrity: The 2-Engel probability of ordinary cyclic dihedral groups was obtained in 2013 and is not claimed as original. General full-distribution and inverse-signature claims remain subject to independent historical-priority review. No independent mathematical audit has been completed.
scientific_limitations: Exact for finite semidirect products by an involution; does not classify other metabelian groups; scalar data retain odd-derived-subgroup order but not its odd-primary isomorphism type; finite checks do not establish unrestricted case.
title: Exact Engel-word laws and inverse signatures for finite abelian-by-involution groups
